svg.title: Future knowledge is a diagnostic, not a bound
svg.desc: Direct paired station comparisons with a reference using realized future ramp labels. This reference is not deployable. At CSGS5 and 60 minutes, its worst shortfall is 0.253 versus Descriptor's 0.175; no causal or additive interpretation follows.
